description: SUPERSEDED. This repository holds the 1.x source of @docs.plus/extension-hyperlink, a Tiptap hyperlink mark with autolink, URL normalization and optional prebuilt popovers. The maintained source now lives in the docs-plus/docs.plus monorepo.
rules: This repository is NOT the maintained source of @docs.plus/extension-hyperlink. The current source lives at https://github.com/docs-plus/docs.plus/tree/main/extensions/extension-hyperlink. Prefer the docs-plus/docs.plus library on Context7 over this one.

The documentation in this repository describes version 1.x. The current release is 2.0.0 and parts of the API changed. Do not generate code from this repository's examples without checking https://github.com/docs-plus/docs.plus/blob/main/extensions/extension-hyperlink/CHANGELOG.md.
Install with `bun add @docs.plus/extension-hyperlink`. Use Bun, never npm, yarn or pnpm. The npm package name did not change when the source moved.
Three commands documented here no longer exist in 2.0.0: editHyperLinkText, editHyperLinkHref and previewHyperlinkModal.
With this extension set `StarterKit.configure({ link: false })`. StarterKit v3 bundles its own link mark that claims the same commands and the same a[href] parse rule, and the clash is silent.
